Each is a fully-furnished and fully-serviced apartment with a fully-equipped kitchen, cleaned and beautifully prepared for your arrival. Enjoy the convenience of work desks and sofas for small meetings, complemented by high-speed Wi-Fi for uninterrupted productivity. Experience the freedom to dine in at fully-equipped kitchens, featuring stovetops, ovens, microwaves, dishwashers, and refrigerators. Additional amenities include Smart TVs with Netflix, Nespresso machines, and safe boxes.

buildings.name: master Bat Yam
buildings.intro: Welcome to master's brand-new Serviced Apartments in Bat Yam. Make yourself at home, whether on a business or family trip, for a short stay or an extended period of time.
buildings.more: Our beautifully-designed, modern, spacious units, featuring fully-equipped kitchens, and space to work are what set us apart. Work hard – at the nearby major industrial parks; Play hard – 6 minutes from the beach by foot, and only minutes away from Tel Aviv by light rail. Savor seamless comfort outside the hustle and bustle of the city.
buildings.aptIntro: Enjoy the best of both worlds: Bat Yam Serviced Apartments combines convenience and style. Far from the chaos, congestion and traffic jams of Tel Aviv, and within easy reach of the industrial parks of Yavne, Rishon LeZion, Holon and Me'uyan Soreq, you'll save time and frustration and get more quality work done.
buildings.aptMore: Our suites are thoughtfully designed to ensure you can comfortably host business guests, hold meetings in the living area and knock out some serious work at your desk. Make the most of your full-size kitchen to cook a meal for you and your guests or chill in front of the TV and catch up on your favorite show. You'll be glad to know that the new red line of the Greater Tel Aviv tramway is already up and running, giving you easy access to the “city that never sleeps”. From the flexibility of contactless self check-in at our lobby's kiosk to 24/7 personal service, Bat Yam Serviced Apartments offers its guests high standards of style and comfort. The 55 apartments are all tastefully-decorated with soothing color schemes. All have fully-equipped kitchens, Egyptian cotton bedding, artisanal toiletries, a Smart TV with Netflix and blazing-fast Wi-Fi. Moreover, each floor has a large room with multiple workstations, which can also be used as a meeting room. There is a self-service laundry room, complimentary for our business and long-staying guests, a fully-equipped gym, a yoga room as well as lockers to store your luggage in. Bat Yam Serviced Apartments means effortless work and relaxation – close enough to the city but far enough to get away!
